examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, ājīvasampadā? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sammāājīvo hoti, sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti.

kā sampattī'ti yā c'assa sīlasampadā c'eva ājīvasampadā ca, sā sampatti, ye c'assa ratanabhāvādikarā saddh'ādayo pañca dhammā. yath'āha, pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañ'ca hoti, upāsakapadumañ'ca, upāsakapuṇḍarīkañ'ca.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, ājīvavipatti? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco micchāājīvo hoti, micchāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti.

11402.commentary: (THa) ājīvahetū'ti ājīvakāraṇā jīvik'āpakato hutvā ājīvikābhayena ahaṃ na nikkhamiṃ na pabbajiṃ.

11403.meaning1: ascetic; member of a renunciant sect; (comm) naked ascetic

examples.text: addasā kho maṃ, bhikkhave, upako ājīviko antarā ca gayaṃ antarā ca bodhiṃ addhānamaggappaṭipannaṃ. disvāna maṃ etadavoca, vippasannāni kho te, āvuso, indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto!

11405.meaning2: danger to one's livelihood; fear concerning livelihood

11406.meaning2: making a livelihood; earning for live
11406.commentary: (MNa) dubbhikkh'ādīsu jīvituṃ asakkonto pabbajito ājīvik'āpakato nāma, ājīvikāya pakato abhibhūto'ti attho. (SNa) ājīvik'āpakatā'ti ājīvikāya upaddutā abhibhūtā, puttadāraṃ posetuṃ asakkontā'ti attho.
11406.notes: The commentary suggests pakata , but apakata 'done wrongly' makes more contextual sense.

examples.text: tañ'ca kho etaṃ, bhikkhave, kulaputtā upenti atthavasikā, atthavasaṃ paṭicca, n'eva rāj'ābhinītā, na cor'ābhinītā, na iṇ'aṭṭā, na bhay'aṭṭā, na ājīvik'āpakatā

11408.meaning1: mode of existence; way of life

11411.meaning2: faculty of resolving to know something unknown

11414.commentary: (DNa) tassa ca nagarā ahu antalikkhe sumāpitā'ti tassa rañño ākāse suṭṭhu māpitā ete āṭānāṭ'ādikā nagarā ahesuṃ, nagarāni bhaviṃsū'ti attho. ekañ'hi'ssa nagaraṃ āṭānāṭā nāma āsi, ekaṃ kusināṭā nāma, ekaṃ parakusināṭā nāma, ekaṃ nāṭasūriyā nāma, ekaṃ parakusiṭanāṭā nāma.

examples.text: tassa ca nagarā ahu, antalikkhe sumāpitā, āṭānāṭā kusināṭā parakusināṭā, nāṭasuriyā parakusiṭanāṭā.

tattha santi uḷārā yakkhā nivāsino, ye imasmiṃ bhagavato pāvacane appasannā. tesaṃ pasādāya uggaṇhātu, bhante, bhagavā āṭānāṭiyaṃ rakkhaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ guttiyā rakkhāya avihiṃsāya phāsuvihārāyā'ti.
siṅgāl'āṭānāṭiyakaṃ, saṅgīti ca das'uttaraṃ, ekādasahi suttehi, pāthikavaggo'ti vuccati.
sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, dasārahānaṃ āṇako nāma mudiṅgo ahosi. tassa dasārahā ānake ghaṭite aññaṃ āṇiṃ odahiṃsu.

11420.grammar: nt, abstr, from na anaṇa, neg
11420.meaning1: freedom from debt; being debt-free; being out of debt

examples.text: seyyathā'pi… āṇaṇyaṃ yathā ārogyaṃ yathā bandhanāmokkhaṃ yathā bhujissaṃ yathā khem'antabhūmiṃ
acchindāpeyyā'ti aññaṃ āṇāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. sakiṃ āṇatto bahukam'pi acchindati, nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
nikkaḍḍhāpeyyā'ti aññaṃ āṇāpeti, āpatti pācittiyassa. sakiṃ āṇatto bahuke'pi dvāre atikkāmeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

11423.commentary: (VINa) āṇattī'ti pana nissayapaṇāmanā vuccati. tasmā paṇāmemi tan'ti vā mā idha paṭikkamī'ti vā nīhara te pattacīvaran'ti vā n'āhaṃ tayā upaṭṭhātabbo'ti vā'ti iminā pāḷinayena mā maṃ gāmappavesanaṃ āpucchī'ti-ādinā pāḷimuttakanayena vā yo nissayapaṇāmanāya paṇāmito hoti, tena upajjhāyo khamāpetabbo.

examples.text: cha'y'imā, bhikkhave, nissayapaṭippassaddhiyo ācariyamhā, ācariyo pakkanto vā hoti, vibbhanto vā, kālaṅ'kato vā, pakkhasaṅkanto vā, āṇatti'y'eva pañcamī, upajjhāyena vā samodhānagato hoti.

idāni tīsu'pi dvāresu āyūhanacetanā samodhānetabbā. seyyath'idaṃ, kāyadvāre sayaṃkatamūlikā vīsati cetanā, āṇattimūlikā vīsati, sampajānamūlikā vīsati, asampajānamūlikā vīsatī'ti asīti cetanā honti, tathā vacīdvāre.
so, bhariyaṃ me nissāya bhayena uppannena bhavitabban'ti cintetvā rañño āṇaṃ paṭibāhituṃ asakkonto gantvā rājānaṃ vanditvā aṭṭhāsi
seyyathā'pi saha bhaṇḍena gahitacoraṃ, vadhetha nan'ti rañño āṇāya rājapurisā bandhitvā catukke catukke pahārasatāni dentā āghātanaṃ nenti.

11428.meaning1: sphere of power; domain of influence

examples.text: 415, 451. āṇāty'āsiṭṭhe'nuttakāle pañcamī.
āṇāti-atthe ca āsīs'atthe ca anuttakāle pañcamīvibhatti hoti. karotu kusalaṃ, sukhaṃ te hotu.

11430.meaning2: who gives an order; who passes on an order

11431.commentary: (VINt) āṇāpanan'ti vacīviññatti-sahitāya vadhakacetanāya adhippet'atthasādhanaṃ. ten'eva sāvetu'kāmo na sāvetī'ti-ādi vuttaṃ.

examples.text: āṇattiko'ti aññaṃ āṇāpentassa evaṃ vijjhitvā vā paharitvā vā mārehī'ti āṇāpanaṃ.
dhovā'ti āṇāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. dhotāni nissaggiyāni honti. rajā'ti āṇāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. rattāni nissaggiyāni honti. vijaṭehī'ti āṇāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. vijaṭitāni nissaggiyāni honti.

sādhu, devo, vāhanāgāresu ca dvāresu ca āṇāpetu, yena vāhanena jīvako icchati tena vāhanena gacchatu, yena dvārena icchati tena dvārena gacchatu, yaṃ kālaṃ icchati taṃ kālaṃ gacchatu, yaṃ kālaṃ icchati taṃ kālaṃ pavisatū'ti.

11437.meaning2: to command; to order; to direct

11438.meaning1: having commanded; having ordered; having informed

examples.text: maggena chādentassa dve magge adhiṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ maggaṃ āṇāpetvā pakkamitabbaṃ. pariyāyena chādentassa dve pariyāye adhiṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ pariyāyaṃ āṇāpetvā pakkamitabbaṃ.
apanidhāpeyya vā'ti aññaṃ āṇāpesi, āpatti pācittiyassa. sakiṃ āṇatto bahukam'pi apanidheti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dakkho palagaṇḍo vā palagaṇḍ'antevāsī vā sukhumāya āṇiyā oḷārikaṃ āṇiṃ abhinihaneyya abhinīhareyya abhinivatteyya.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, dasārahānaṃ ānako nāma mudiṅgo ahosi. tassa dasārahā ānake ghaṭite aññaṃ āṇiṃ odahiṃsu.

11442.commentary: (DNa) rathass'āṇī'va yāyato'ti yathā āṇiyā sati'y'eva ratho yāti, asati na yāti, evaṃ imesu saṅgahesu sati'y'eva loko vattati, asati na vattati. tena vuttaṃ, ete kho saṅgahā loke, rathass'āṇī'va yāyato'ti.

examples.text: dānañ'ca peyyavajjañ'ca, atthacariyā ca yā idha, samān'attatā ca dhammesu, tattha tattha yath'ārahaṃ, ete kho saṅgahā loke, rathass'āṇī'va yāyato.

11444.meaning2: small gate or a bolted gate

11445.meaning1: external part of the female sexual organ

11446.meaning1: mass of nails; collection of pegs
11446.commentary: (SNa) āṇisaṅghāṭo'va avasissī'ti suvaṇṇ'ādimayānaṃ āṇīnaṃ saṅghāṭamattam'eva avasesaṃ ahosi. ath'assa dvādasayojanappamāṇo saddo antosālāyam'pi dukkhena suyyittha.

examples.text: ahu kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ ānakassa mudiṅgassa porāṇaṃ pokkharaphalakaṃ antaradhāyi. āṇisaṅghāṭo'va avasissi.

11448.meaning2: pin of a wheel-axle; linchpin; peg; bolt

11449.synonym: aṭṭi, ābādha, āmaya, gada, gilānabhāva, byādhi, roga, vyādhi

examples.text: ātaṅkaphassena khudāya phuṭṭho, sītaṃ atuṇhaṃ adhivāsayeyya, so tehi phuṭṭho bahudhā anoko, vīriyaṃ parakkammadaḷhaṃ kareyya.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'ābādho hoti app'ātaṅko, samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato n'ātisītāya n'āccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo samayo padhānāya.

11450.meaning2: contact with disease; touch, sensation of sickness

11452.meaning2: drum covered with leather on all sides

11454.meaning1: heat; heat of the sun; sunshine

examples.text: phuṭṭhassa me aññatarena byādhinā, rogena bāḷhaṃ dukhitassa ruppato, parisussati khippam'idaṃ kaḷevaraṃ, pupphaṃ yathā paṃsuni ātape kataṃ.
paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cīvaraṃ paṭisevāmi yāva'd'eva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-siriṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya yāva'd'eva hirikopīnapaṭicchādan'atthaṃ

11459.commentary: (MNa) ātappāyā'ti kilesa-santāpaka-vīriya-karaṇ'atthāya. (MNa) ajj'eva kiccam'ātappan'ti kilesānaṃ ātāpanaparitāpanena ātappan'ti laddhanāmaṃ vīriyaṃ ajj'eva kātabbaṃ.

examples.text: tumhehi kiccam'ātappaṃ, akkhātāro tathāgatā, paṭipannā pamokkhanti, jhāyino mārabandhanā.
tenah'ātappaṃ karohi, idh'eva nipako sato, ito sutvāna nigghosaṃ, sikkhe nibbānam'attano.

11460.meaningLit: discourse on exertion should be made

11461.commentary: (DNa) te ca ātappam'akaruṃ, sutvā buddhassa sāsanan'ti te ca bhikkhū taṃ buddhasāsanaṃ sutvā tāva'd'eva tadatthāya vīriyaṃ kariṃsu.

examples.text: devakāyā abhikkantā, te vijānātha bhikkhavo, te ca ātappam'akaruṃ, sutvā buddhassa sāsanaṃ.

11462.commentary: (DNa) ātappam'anvāyā'ti-ādīsu vīriyaṃ kilesānaṃ ātāpanabhāvena ātappan'ti vuttaṃ. tadeva padahanavasena padhānaṃ. punappunaṃ yuttavasena anuyogo'ti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
bhūtena kho pana vuccamāno avajānāti, no paṭijānāti. abhūtena vuccamāno na ātappaṃ karoti, tassa nibbeṭhanāya iti'p'etaṃ atacchaṃ iti'p'etaṃ abhūtan'ti.
iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpana-paritāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attan'tapo hoti attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto.

11467.meaning1: devoted to the practice of torturing and mortifying oneself

examples.text: iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpana-paritāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attan'tapo hoti attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto.

yato kho, bhikkhave, usukārassa tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpitaṃ hoti paritāpitaṃ ujuṃ kataṃ kammaniyaṃ, na so taṃ aparena samayena usukāro tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpeti paritāpeti ujuṃ karoti kammaniyaṃ.

11470.meaning1: avid; ardent; zealous; keen; with continuous effort
11470.commentary: (DNa) ātāpī'ti kāyikacetasika-saṅkhātena vīriy'ātāpena ātāpī. (NIDD1) ātāpī'ti. ātappaṃ vuccati vīriyaṃ. yo cetasiko vīriy'ārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī thāmo ṭhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittacchandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggaho vīriyaṃ vīriy'indriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo. iminā ātāpena upeto samupeto upagato samupagato upapanno samupapanno samannāgato so vuccati ātāpī'ti, jāgariyaṃ bhajeyya ātāpī.

examples.text: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.
niddaṃ na bahulīkareyya, jāgariyaṃ bhajeyya ātāpī, tandiṃ māyaṃ hassaṃ khiḍḍaṃ, methunaṃ vippajahe savibhūsaṃ.
yv'āyaṃ, bhante, puggalo attan'tapo attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto so attānaṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ n'ārādheti.
tasmā na aparena samayena dukkhāya attānaṃ padahati. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, usukāro tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpeti paritāpeti ujuṃ karoti kammaniyaṃ.

11475.meaning2: gift of hospitality, gift to a guest

examples.text: katamāni dve? āmis'ātitheyyañ'ca dhamm'ātitheyyañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve ātitheyyāni.

11476.notes: CPD suggests a masculine correspondent of mātu. Or possibly a contraction of ātumaṃ 'one's own'.

11477.grammar: masc, atta group, from sk ātman

11479.meaning1: name of a town between Kusinārā and Sāvatthī

examples.text: ekam'id'āhaṃ, pukkusa, samayaṃ ātumāyaṃ viharāmi bhusāgāre.

11480.meaning1: whose father and mother have died

examples.text: bhikkhussa ātumātumārī! varaṃ te, bhikkhu, tiṇhena govikantanena kucchi parikanto, na tv'eva varaṃ yaṃ ratt'andhakāratimisāyaṃ kucchihetu piṇḍāya carasī'ti.

11482.meaning1: whose father has died; with a dead father
11482.commentary: (MNa) ātumārī mātumārī'ti ettha ātū'ti pitā, mātū'ti mātā. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, yassa pitā vā mātā vā atthi, taṃ mātāpitaro amhākaṃ puttako'ti yathā tathā vā uppādetvā yaṃkiñci khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ datvā ekasmiṃ ṭhāne sayāpenti. so evaṃ rattiṃ piṇḍāya na carati. tuyhaṃ pana mātāpitaro matā maññe, tena evaṃ carasī'ti.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhagini, pisāco, bhikkhu piṇḍāya ṭhito'ti. bhikkhussa ātumārī, bhikkhussa mātumārī!
susukhaṃ vata jīvāma, āturesu anāturā, āturesu manussesu, viharāma anāturā.
uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, ko attho supitena vo, āturānañ'hi kā niddā, sallaviddhāna ruppataṃ.
aham'asmi, bhante, jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇ'ātaṅko.
tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, āturakāyassa me sato cittaṃ anāturaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabban'ti.
na hi pana taṃ, gahapati, paṭibhāsi bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ paṭipucchituṃ, kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, āturakāyo c'eva hoti āturacitto ca, kittāvatā ca pana āturakāyo hi kho hoti no ca āturacitto'ti?

11486.meaning1: fact of being sick; fact of being diseased

examples.text: parittānam'pi, mahārāja, pavattīyamānānaṃ saddo suyyati, jivhā sukkhati, hadayaṃ byāvaṭṭati, kaṇṭho āturati. tena tesaṃ pavattena sabbe byādhayo vūpasaman'ti, sabbā ītiyo apagacchantī'ti.
tatra, bhikkhave, taramānassa bhāsato kāyo'pi kilamati, cittam'pi upahaññati, saro'pi upahaññati, kaṇṭho'pi āturīyati, avisaṭṭham'pi hoti aviññeyyaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ.

11493.meaning2: who has taken a stick in hand, who has embraced violence

11495.meaning2: intent on what one has taken up

examples.text: āthabbaṇaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ, no vidahe atho'pi nakkhattaṃ, virutañ'ca gabbhakaraṇaṃ, tikicchaṃ māmako na seveyya.

11497.meaning2: (what belongs to) the Atharva-veda; spell or a charm from the Atharva-veda

examples.text: desetu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ, desetu sugato saṃkhittena dhammaṃ, app'eva nām'āhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyaṃ. app'eva nām'āhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa dāy'ādo assan'ti.
kammassako'mhi kammadāya-ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo. yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmi.
